later_authority_checked.effect_on_F6_F7_law: Confirms the R9 execution lane and launches this F6/F7 conservation court. It does NOT supersede, narrow or extend HQD-125's F6/F7 law.

F6_binding_law.statement: Multiple survey/source worlds may contribute to one objective social world.
No implicit pooling, same-respondent fiction, or portability assumption is allowed.
Different families/waves may contribute distinct lawful empirical or structural fields when exact scope, comparability and composition authority permit.
Source/universe provenance and typed limits must be preserved.
Field Forge may constitute actor-independent structural relations only within exact authority and must not erase or substitute for upstream empirical producers.

F7_binding_law.statement: Same-survey comparable waves may constitute temporal movement.
Cross-wave temporal products require exact identity, scope, response-surface and comparability authority.
Temporal products may concern distributions, determinicity, branches, clouds/joints, structural relations/pressure, contradiction/alignment/divergence, uncertainty and noncomparability.

F8_binding_law.statement: F8 is downstream and must consume possibility/world products without violating the actor firewall.
Parent/coparent priors remain possibility distributions, not persons, biographies, personalities or V3 actor states.

gate_definitions.F6: PYAT_CONTROL_ROOM/24_HQD125_DDM_FUNCTIONAL_CONSERVATION_AND_PREV3_ACCEPTANCE_LAW.md §12: multiple survey/source worlds can contribute to one objective social world under exact scope/comparability/composition authority without false pooling.
gate_definitions.F7: PYAT_CONTROL_ROOM/24_HQD125_DDM_FUNCTIONAL_CONSERVATION_AND_PREV3_ACCEPTANCE_LAW.md §12: comparable same-survey waves can produce lawful temporal movement / pressure fields with typed non-comparability where required.

jurisdiction_crosswalk_F6_F7.critical_caveat: This crosswalk establishes JURISDICTION, not proof that every functional edge is already implemented or occupied.

architecture_reopen_law.threshold: Reopen ONLY if a required functional responsibility has no lawful current representation, no owner, cannot be transported, cannot be validated/refused, cannot be composed at the required grain, AND cannot be satisfied by lawful same-grain succession or bounded implementation under the present DAG.
architecture_reopen_law.otherwise_remedy: implementation, authority materialization, composition or qualification — NOT resurrection of historical stage topology.

critical_status_law.note: F6 and F7 are NOT satisfied by the R9 source-free work. R9 concerns source access accounting, which is upstream of and orthogonal to F6/F7.
